messages:
nina.ops: FYI team — were opening Dedicated Quantum-XP pools in europe-north1 (stockholm) as a GA launch on 2026-06-01 07:00 UTC. This is GA but will start with soft quotas for placement stability. Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/dedicated/quantum-xp-sto
omar.prod: Quick summary for product teams? who can get access day one?
nina.ops: GA but with soft-quota limits for first 72h: default per-account replica cap = 5. Enterprise customers with committed contracts can request higher caps via infra-ops. Self-serve reservations allowed but capped initially.
ops-bot: @channel Provisioning window: 2026-06-01 07:00-09:00 UTC. Expect capacity additions in europe-north1 and minor CA balancing. No customer-facing downtime planned.
carmen.sales: Sales note: pricing stays per-token. Theres a one-time "early-stabilization" uplift of 7% for reservations created in the first billing cycle to offset rollout costs. Avoid promising unlimited immediate capacity.
sre-oncall: SRE note: Quantum-XP hardware = 200 TF infer-class, 256GB HBM, specialized kernels for very long-context KV caching. We'll enforce stricter eviction thresholds during first 48h and disable cross-zone burst fallback for isolation. Monitor tail-latency dashboards closely.
docsguide: Console UX question: do we show tuning guidance for customers who migrate?
nina.ops: Yes — Console migration flow will display a "Quantum tuning" checklist with recommended batching, KV cache sizes, and an example autoscale snippet. Also publishing a short playbook + rollback steps in the docs.
carmen.sales: When will the customer bulletin go out?
omar.prod: Draft bulletin will be posted to #eng-runtime tomorrow 09:30 UTC for review; target send to customers 2026-05-28 after final QA.
sre-oncall: Oncall will be watching the provisioning window. If you see increased 5xx or tail-latency spikes, tag @sre-oncall and open an incident channel.
nina.ops: Thanks all — reminders: do not promise uncapped self-serve capacity until we lift the soft-quotas, communicate the per-account caps, and route special limit requests to infra-ops. :rocket:
